content:
alejandra-sales: Maria from Contoso hitting 413 when sending full page HTML + screenshots for the POC. Demo in <24h, need a quick unblock.

maria-cust: We're posting ~11.6MB JSON over POST to /v1/infer. Body contains `html` (300KB) + `screenshots` array 9 x ~1.2MB base64 PNGs. Response is `HTTP/1.1 413` with nginx proxy msg.

raj-se: That size will get blocked by the gateway. Fast options: presign + upload, client gzip, or split into several smaller calls and stitch on our side. Presign is usually lowest-friction.

alejandra-sales: Customer prefers minimal client changes. Can we offer a single presigned multipart flow so they can PUT one object?

toni-ops: Yes. I can spin a short-lived presign we host on our transient blobstore with eu-west-1 fetchers. Will create PUT presign that accepts gzipped ndjson. Will also switch fetcher to regional node so data doesn't leave EU.

security-bot: Note: Contoso requires no third-party storage. Confirming our transient blobstore is in-region and ephemeral. Audit logging will be captured.

toni-ops: Presign created: `ps-contoso-0316`. URL (sent privately). TTL=45m. Accepts `Content-Encoding: gzip`.

raj-se: Suggested ingestion flow to send to the customer:
```
# 1) compress + upload
gzip -c docs_with_images.ndjson > docs.ndjson.gz
curl -X PUT "<PRESIGN_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" --data-binary @docs.ndjson.gz

# 2) call infer with pointer
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer
{
  "model": "rwd-8k",
  "context_url": "<PRESIGN_URL>?signature=...",
  "context_type": "ndjson-gz",
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```
Server will fetch, stream-decompress, and tokenize. We bill for tokens produced by tokenization.

maria-cust: If you fetch and tokenize, will we be charged? We're doing a POC and want credit. Also want to know retention policy for the uploaded blob.

alejandra-sales: I'll confirm billing.

toni-ops: For POC accounts we can apply promo credit; I'll request 250k free tokens for this trial. Retention: blobs auto-delete after 2h by default for presign uploads; we can set 30m for this one. Checksums stored in audit only.

security-bot: I verified fetch originates from EU IP pool and the presign bucket ACL is private. Audit ID logged.

raj-se: Also advise they avoid uploading raw base64 JSON. Converting attachments to gzipped ndjson with references reduces tokenization overhead and speeds ingestion. We'll include a quick script.

maria-cust: Uploaded and called infer with pointer. Received 200 and response tokens look correct. Thanks everyone.

alejandra-sales: Great — I'm documenting the flow and follow-ups (billing credit, retention change). Closing thread. :tada:
